meta.provenanceNote: Derived by extracting the hash-verified official nodejs.org v22.22.1 headers archive outside the repository and listing every regular file under include/node with POSIX path, byte size, and lowercase sha256. Paths are relative to the node-gyp cache version root.
meta.scopeNote: Exact consumed Node/V8/UV/OpenSSL header plus build-metadata surface node-gyp exposes to compilers (the whole declared include/node root). The win-x64 linker input x64/node.lib ships in the main distribution, not this archive; its byte hash is pinned separately below against the official SHASUMS256.txt.
meta.enforcementNote: Runtime must reject missing files, extra files, size or hash changes, reparse points anywhere inside the declared roots, and any node.lib whose bytes do not match nodeLib.sha256, before node-gyp configure runs.
